questions.text: What is the primary purpose of an ERP system?
options: B. To integrate and manage organisational business processes

questions.text: SAP MM mainly deals with:
Which organisational element generally represents a physical location where materials are produced, stored or managed?
A storage location is normally associated with:
Which master record contains basic information about a material used or purchased by an organisation?
Which record contains important information about a supplier?
options: B. Vendor or business partner master

questions.text: Which document normally initiates an internal request to purchase a material or service?
What is the purpose of a request for quotation?
options: A. To receive materials into stock
B. To ask suppliers to submit prices and commercial terms
C. To make payment to a supplier
D. To issue materials from a warehouse

questions.text: After quotations are received from different suppliers, the organisation should normally:
Which document is issued to a selected supplier to formally order materials or services?
Goods receipt indicates that:
options: A. A purchase request has been rejected
B. Ordered materials have been received
C. A supplier has been deleted
D. Payment has already been completed

questions.text: Three-way matching generally compares:
options: A. Purchase requisition, quotation and payment
B. Purchase order, goods receipt and supplier invoice
C. Material master, vendor master and plant
D. Invoice, credit memo and bank statement

questions.text: Which process records materials leaving inventory for consumption or another purpose?
Physical inventory is conducted mainly to:
options: B. Compare actual stock with system-recorded stock

questions.text: Moving materials from one plant or storage location to another is known as:
In a consignment process, materials are generally:
options: A. Owned by the customer before delivery
B. Owned by the supplier until they are consumed or withdrawn
C. Immediately treated as damaged stock

questions.text: What is the purpose of a release or approval procedure?
options: A. To control and authorise procurement documents
C. To design the SAP screen

questions.text: Vendor performance analysis may include the evaluation of:
options: A. Delivery reliability, quality and pricing

questions.text: Which is the most responsible way to use AI during the internship?
options: A. Copy AI-generated content without reading it
B. Submit AI-generated answers as one’s own work
C. Verify AI-generated information and demonstrate personal understanding
D. Share confidential project information with public AI tools

questions.text: An AI tool generates a process explanation that appears incorrect. What should the student do?
options: B. Verify it, correct the errors and discuss it with the mentor
C. Hide the use of AI
D. Copy the same response into every project document
